g.title: crate Arvane native backend for top-level and embedded child windows.
crate::a11y Converts accepted shell semantics to the native AccessKit adapter.
crate::display Initial window placement and display frame pacing.
crate::display::placement Chooses window positions on monitors and centers windows in their work areas.
crate::display::placement::tests Tests for startup placement in physical monitor work areas.
crate::display::refresh Turns a monitor's reported refresh rate into a frame period.
crate::display::windows Read the Windows monitor work area for initial window placement.
crate::module Keep library code mapped while its threads or providers may still run.
crate::native_input Native input handling and translation.
crate::native_input::locale Reads the current system locale.
crate::native_input::state Stores native input and IME state.
crate::native_input::system Portable queries of system input settings and file-drag tracking.
crate::open Opening and revealing file paths.
crate::port Native window and input ports.
crate::port::embed Shared embedded window lifecycle and entry points.
crate::port::embed::child Share embedded child commands and implement the host handle contract.
crate::port::embed::child::tests Tests for host command coalescing, stop notices and panic messages.
crate::port::embed::geometry Checked logical to physical child sizing.
crate::port::embed::keys Pair unhandled key presses with their releases for one embedded child.
crate::port::embed::keys::tests Tests of the key probe and release pairing.
crate::port::embed::open Native child window creation in the host event loop.
crate::port::embed::resize Answer resize requests now or after the host confirms the size.
crate::port::embed::resize::tests Tests of resize answers, host confirmation, cancellation and timeout.
crate::port::embed::session Own the embedded UI lifecycle, handler and module-retention sentinel.
crate::port::embed::surface The embedded child's surface presence, derived from its visibility.
crate::port::embed::surface::tests Tests of the surface presence derived from visibility.
crate::port::win32 Win32 embedded children, owned by the host GUI thread.
crate::port::win32::a11y UIA messages and state publication.
crate::port::win32::bridge Synchronous UIA adapter, independent from application callback borrows.
crate::port::win32::create Validates the Win32 parent and creates the child window on its GUI thread.
crate::port::win32::dpi Thread-scoped parent DPI awareness, never process-wide settings.
crate::port::win32::ime Child-window IMM32 composition and candidate placement.
crate::port::win32::input Win32 mouse normalization, keyboard text and synchronous cursor answers.
crate::port::win32::native Keep Win32 identity, message ids and the host-facing ChildPort below dispatch.
crate::port::win32::proc Win32 dispatch with an independently retained Rc on every entry.
crate::port::win32::services Native dialog ownership and shell file drops for embedded windows.
crate::port::win32::state UI-only callback state, separate from synchronous wndproc answers.
crate::port::win32::state::tests Tests of UTF-16 decoding: pairs and lone surrogates decode in one push.
crate::port::win32::target Raw presentation target; retaining it never destroys a host window.
crate::port::win32::test_parent Real Win32 host window for embedding end-to-end tests.
crate::port::win32::window Embedded ShellWindow services and synchronous CPU/GPU presentation.
crate::port::winit Winit window and input port.
crate::port::winit::contacts Maps winit contacts and native metadata to portable pointer input.
crate::port::winit::foreign The native child window that fills a window whose content another
crate::port::winit::foreign::win32 Win32 implementation of the child window that fills a foreign window.
crate::port::winit::open Creates one winit window from a window request.
crate::port::winit::runtime Main-thread event loop and window life cycle.
crate::port::winit::shell_loop The native loop as a shell handler sees it during one callback.
crate::port::winit::wheel Converts native wheel notches to logical scroll distances.
crate::port::winit::window A winit window with its CPU presentation surface and platform services.
crate::port::winit::window_events Turns winit window events into shell events for one native window.
crate::port::winit::windows The open windows of the native loop, by app id and by winit id.
crate::present The softbuffer CPU surface of a window and whether it shows a frame.
crate::probe Answers whether a native window handle is still alive (test feature).
crate::services Window-owned clipboard and native file dialog services.
crate::wait Bounded shutdown waits on a native window's owning thread.
crate::wake Converts shell wake reasons to atomic native event-loop storage.
